evidence.quote: The area under Onion cultivation is expected to increase by 2.31% (0.46 Lakh Ha) over 2024-25 i.e. to 20.14 Lakh Ha in 2025-26 from 19.68 Lakh Ha in 2024-25. The production of Onion is expected to be 307.37 Lakh Tonne in 2025-26 as compared to 307.67 Lakh Tonne in 2024-25.

method: Our arithmetic: 1,547,940 / 30,737,000 = 5.04%. FY (Apr-Mar) exports vs crop year; approximate.
